most species are gall formers or less specialized plant feeders. The Stomatosematidi and some others are fungivores, which is presumably the ancestral diet. The Aphidoletini and Lestodiplosini in the Cecidomyiidi, and some others, are predators and they can be very abundant in Malaise trap samples (M Jaschhof, pers. comm.). Since the predators do not form a monophyletic group, and life history data are missing for many Cecidomyiinae, it does not appear feasible to separate them out at the moment.
